source_text: Parents elect Brit Shalom as an alternative to Brit Milah primarily due to ethical objections to neonatal circumcision, emphasizing the procedure's status as a non-therapeutic surgery performed without the infant's consent, which they regard as a violation of bodily autonomy and an infliction of unnecessary pain and potential trauma.
